definitions.name: terp_recovery_hash_RecoveryHashAlg
definitions.description:
Supported break-glass digest algorithms.

Extend this enum when adding host/circuit-backed hashes; keep serde names stable.

blake2b256.description: BLAKE2b-512 truncated to 32 bytes (first 32 of 64-byte output).

poseidon_pallas.description:
Poseidon over Pallas base field (`P128Pow5T3`). See module docs for the
fixed instance (byte mapping, fold, 32-byte LE field encoding).

sha256d.description: Double SHA-256: `SHA256(SHA256(x))` — each "round" is one double-hash.

definitions.name: cosmwasm_std_binary_Binary
definitions.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization
with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>.
See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.
